candidates.decision_relevance: Would let the weekly reviews and daily analyses distinguish rebounds, selloffs, and late repairs, and assess whether weakness preceded or followed other observations rather than relying on endpoints or mismatched windows.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly reviews repeatedly lack numerical, time-ordered BTC/ETH paths; daily outputs report sampled hourly ETH/BTC closes but note incomplete or mismatched price-window spans.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamp-aligned hourly BTC, ETH, and ETH/BTC prices
candidates.missing_history_problem: The supplied histories do not provide a continuous, consistently aligned multi-asset price path suitable for reconstructing intraperiod sequence against the cited observations and analysis cutoffs.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would make it possible to distinguish persistent participation deterioration or recovery from a single snapshot, and to assess whether breadth changes preceded or followed price moves.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily analyses use point-in-time Top-100 breadth proxies with changing membership hashes; weekly reviews cite missing W44 breadth sequences and repeatedly note that proxy methodology and timing are unavailable.
candidates.metric_name: Constituent-level breadth history with membership and timestamp
candidates.missing_history_problem: Available breadth observations are sparse, point-in-time proxies rather than a comparable longitudinal series; changes across captures cannot be cleanly separated from membership changes or retrieval timing.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would allow flow evidence to be evaluated for persistence, asset divergence, and ordering relative to price and breadth changes, without treating an older settled session as current evidence.
candidates.evidence_reference: The weekly reviews explicitly lack W44 settled-flow rows and caution against carrying W43 flow detail forward; daily analyses repeatedly identify October 30 as the latest supplied settled session.
candidates.metric_name: Per-session settled BTC and ETH ETF flows
candidates.missing_history_problem: The supplied records contain isolated settled sessions rather than a complete, dated sequence through the reviewed weeks, leaving intervening and current-period flow persistence unknown.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would permit retrospective assessment of forecast range containment, path errors, and warning-time versus later outcomes while preserving the information available when each candidate was issued.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly reviews repeatedly report missing candidate bounds, issuance times, and candidate-linked outcomes despite counts of matured outcomes; daily outputs include shadow candidates but no linked realized outcome rows.
candidates.missing_history_problem: Candidate specifications, freeze-time evidence snapshots, and matured outcomes are not consistently supplied together, preventing reproducible ex-ante scoring and separation of overlapping observations from independent events.
